title: Checkpoint after conflict-free decisions without revisiting cleared cycles
narrative: After a decision is settled, the nodes it still conflicts with are revisited, and nodes already visited are not revisited so a circular conflict cannot loop forever. A checkpoint is taken only when the decision has no remaining conflicts; a conflict blocked only by the visited set is reported instead of silently saved. The conflicts themselves are still the write-scope conflicts the product already detects (`fangore_tdr_crash_after_accept_before_record`, `fangore_decision_plane_policy`); this adds the revisit-and-checkpoint rule on top. Tracks MH-SR-08[^insp-sr-08].
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/no_conflicts.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
